_comment: Base Sepolia REHEARSAL deployment (2026-11-25, the fourth one, a full redeploy with the owner's go-ahead). Not production. It adds mixed-case claims (Words.claim names each letter's case, decisions.md #17) and one free snack per profile (Staking.feedWithSnack, a signer voucher; plain feed always pays), on top of caretakers, Staking's guard against Words sent to it directly, the pre-mainnet audit fixes, and the 4,584-word dictionary. $WORD here is contracts/test/mocks/MockERC20.sol (permissionless mint(), the in-game testnet faucet), reused from the first rehearsal. No swap router ($WORD-only, as at launch). The AnswerChain head is the throwaway rehearsal schedule. The bounty carve is 1500 bps from deploy. Economy retune (decisions.md #19, with the owner's go-ahead, 2026-11-25, block 63342833, contracts/script/DeployPrestigeLadder.s.sol): every paid split is 75/10/10/5, and Prestige is the word-ladder contract (5 stages, stage fee = base x stage); the old Prestige 0xbE4a96e3a6D49F6f2E623486b4E6FA9459Ec91C6 is no longer a FeeRouter collector, and Words points at the new one.
